Oltretorrente — Parma, Italy

🟡 Local-source safety assessment · 13 areas reviewed individually Methodology →

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Across the torrent from the centre, with the Parco Ducale on its northern edge: historically the working-class side, now mixed and lively. Six community officers were assigned to Oltretorrente alone, and residents report open dealing around the WOPA site. It is a short walk from the Duomo and perfectly normal by day.
